Hi Liza — welcome again and congrats on signing! I attached the countersigned offer for your records and want to outline next steps so we can keep the Feb 1 start date. Please read and reply with the documents below at your earliest convenience.

Immediate asks (should take < 30 minutes):
- Reply with the best phone number and current home address for the background check form.
- Upload a scanned government ID (passport or driver’s license) to the VeriCheck portal (link below) — we need this for identity verification.
- If you have a social security number, include the last 4 digits in your reply (or confirm you’ll provide them via the portal).

Portal (VeriCheck intake): https://portal.vericheck.com/start/AB12345

Attached: Liza_Signed_Offer.pdf (Attachment: Liza_Signed_Offer.pdf (pdf))

Day-one planning: we plan for a remote-first week. Connor (hiring manager) will send a 1st-week runbook once IT confirms provisioning. I’ve cc’d Mina for HR onboarding and Marissa for benefits kick-off.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the vendor and IT after I hear from you.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition

Subject: VeriCheck intake: Redwood Inference - Liza Thompson (action required)

Hello Liza and Redwood team — this is an automated intake from VeriCheck (case ID VC-92217). We received a submission and have two quick outstanding items to complete verification:
1) Please upload one of the following supporting docs to the secure portal: utility bill, bank statement, or lease that matches the address you submitted.
2) For employment verification we will attempt EDD/agencies and may send a verification request to your prior employers. If you prefer to limit outreach, reply to this email and we can adjust the scope.

Portal link: https://portal.vericheck.com/case/VC-92217
Estimated time to complete once docs received: 2–4 business days.

If you have any compliance restrictions (e.g., sealed records), include that note to the case.

Thanks,
VeriCheck Intake Team
